citations.description: Ticket comments array is empty; ticket status is 'in_progress'. No Gerrit change id, LLM-Review +1, or Verified +1 recorded for this specific change.

findings.criterion: AC2: The change is merged via Gerrit with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1, carrying the rebar-ticket trailer.
findings.detail: AC2 is operator-attested (Gerrit merge with specific vote labels is an external operational event). The ticket has no comments and no recorded attestation of a Gerrit merge for this change — no change URL/id, no vote record, no timestamp. The ticket status is still 'in_progress'. There is no concrete attestation satisfying this criterion.
findings.remediation: Record proof as a ticket comment naming: the Gerrit change URL/id for this doc update, the observed LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 votes, the rebar-ticket trailer value, and the merge timestamp.

data.remediation: How to resolve the unmet criteria: for each one, decide whether the work is genuinely incomplete or simply undocumented. If a requirement is already satisfied but the proof is not discoverable from the code alone, add a comment to this ticket that documents the evidence — cite the concrete artifacts that meet the requirement (file paths and line ranges, commands and their output, links, or the reasoning that ties the work to the criterion). The completion verifier reads this ticket's comments, so evidence you record there is taken into account on the next verification. For any criterion whose work is genuinely unfinished, complete it, then re-verify.
